confidence_notes: Two web searches were run: one for the RBA rate and one for Darwin cost-of-living indexes. The RBA search gave 0.6677 USD per AUD for 19 Nov 2026. The RBA page said the 19 Nov value appeared only in a statistics table with inconsistent page metadata, so that figure is less certain than the 18 Nov value of 0.6720. Coffee, beer, and meals draw on aggregated index figures of mixed dates and currencies. Traveltables was last updated in 2023, so I adjusted its figures upward. No cocktail or restaurant wine price was found. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer price: cocktail about 2x, glass of wine about 1.7x. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates only. I did not search for or inspect any listings. Darwin accommodation varies a lot by season, with a dry-season peak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Darwin prices are close to the Australian average, with restaurants slightly higher. Accommodation is based on general knowledge of Darwin's tourist-driven, seasonal market, comparable to Cairns and Alice Springs.
